The Association is composed of over 60 journalists from all over the world who cover the Court. The Association is formally known to the Court and its organs to support the efficiency of press coverage.

The current president is Janet Anderson, a journalist and communications specialist covering justice and accountability. The current vice president is Lian Buan, a journalist covering justice, corruption, and impunity. She is the team lead of the Justice and Human Rights cluster of Rappler in the Philippines.
